headline: Chile Cuts Diesel and Petrol Prices Under New Price-Ceiling Law
summary: Chile's state oil firm ENAP reduced diesel prices by 141.9 pesos and petrol by 38.7 pesos per litre under a newly implemented price-ceiling law following a truckers' strike.
why: Fuel prices act as a major input cost for transportation, manufacturing, and consumer inflation, making state adjustments a key factor for domestic economic stability.

impacts.name: Empresa Nacional del Petróleo
impacts.why: Regulatory price caps implemented by the state firm lower retail fuel prices.
